content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with two programmable controllers set up as master and slave for my project. I want to better understand how to properly connect both controllers together. Is it correct to add network inputs/outputs in the ladder diagram? My current ladder includes four inputs and three outputs. Although it only connects to one controller, my goal is to learn about the master/slave connection. Master: 4 inputs / 2 outputs Slave: 1 output I've tested this setup, but the single output on the slave controller does not provide any feedback. I’d appreciate advice from someone experienced in this area. I am using [product_name] [version_no].
Are you aiming for master/slave communication, or do you want a master/master setup using a client/server arrangement?

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue raised involves challenges in setting up communication between two controllers in a master/slave configuration using [product_name] [version_no]. In testing, the output on the slave controller does not respond, which could be due to incorrect network I/O mapping or configuration in the ladder logic. Users are searching for clear guidance on controller network setup and expect the programming software to make multi-controller configurations more intuitive.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek a simple and effective approach to master/slave configuration between controllers, with clear assignment of network inputs and outputs and accurate real-world feedback on outputs. They expect [product_name] [version_no] to support this process, providing easy-to-follow instructions or validation to confirm correct setup.
